item.title: a little bit about myself
item.description: I’m passionate about technology and societal challenges. My background is in political science, software development, DevOps and now exploring cyber security. Education Leuphana Universität Lüneburg - Bachelor of Arts in Political Science (major), Social Media and Information Systems (minor) 2016 - 2020 Arqus Alliance - Master’s in International Cybersecurity and Cyberintelligence 2025 - present Work Experience MOIA GmbH - DevOps Engineer 2019 - 2022 MOIA GmbH - Software Engineer in Developer Experience
